name: Yongernow Australian Malleefowl Centre
reason: Rule 1: two counted sources: Lonely Planet POI page (opened: 'the excellent, community-managed and volunteer-run Yongergnow Malleefowl Centre is in Ongerup') and the Australia's South West board listing, plus the WA Museum WAnderland listing (opened). Rule 2: interpretive centre with displays on the mallee and malleefowl, captive-raising program, gallery and cafe; open Tue-Sat 9am-4pm, paid entry (about A$12 adult). Rule 3: distinct attraction, the only malleefowl centre. Rule 4: permanent venue. Note: the centre's own spelling is 'Yongergnow' (Shire of Gnowangerup, Lonely Planet); use that name.
objection: Small volunteer-run centre in a tiny wheatbelt town; Lonely Planet itself says to check opening hours (closed Sun-Mon and public holidays), and visitors mostly stop in passing between the Stirling Range and Esperance/Ravensthorpe; only if nearby anyway on the friend test.
